senses.gloss: --a son of स्वाहा and father of Citraratha; the best among givers; performed many sacrifices. वा. ९५. १६-17.
--one of the २० Sutapa गणस्. वा. १००. १५.
(I)--a तुषित god. Br. III. 3. १९.
(II)--the गुण of waters becomes absorbed in ज्योतिस् or तेजस् and consequently waters reach the verge of destruction. वा. १०१. ४२. १०२. 9.

--a व्रत to be performed on the third day of the माघ month; sacred to ललिता; this is continued every month preceded by fasting and followed by gifts to Brahmanas; the person who does this enjoys in the world of गौरी. It is equal to performing १००० यज्ञस्। M. ch. ६३ (whole)
--a companion of Puramjana, allegorically the organ of taste. See मुख्या. भा. IV. २५. ४९; २९. ११.
--fit for gift during the विशोकद्वादशि व्रत। M. ८२. १९.
--a son of the राक्षस Vidyuta. Br. III. 7. ९५.
--son of Kuthumi. वा. ६१. ३८.
--one of the eight सौभाग्यम्स्. M. ६०. 8, २८.
--is a yoga siddhi. Br. IV. ३६. ५२; ४४. १०८.
--the months of Madhu and माधव. Br. II. १३. 9; वा. ३०. 8.
--three-fold, as ब्रह्मा, Rudra and विष्णु; (four- fold, according to another reading; see Wilson's translation). Vi. VI. 8. 7.
--son of काशि (काशेय वि। प्।) and father of दीर्- ghatamas (tapas वि। प्।). भा. IX. १७. 4; Vi. IV. 8. 7.
--one of the nine sons of Ugrasena. भा. IX. २४. २४; Br. III. ७१. १३३; M. ४४. ७५; वा. ९६. १३२; Vi. IV. १४. २०. [page३-079+ २८]
--a daughter of Ugrasena, and wife of सृञ्जय. भा. IX. २४. २५ and ४२; Br. III. ७१. १३४; M. ४४. ७६; वा. ९६. १३३; Vi. IV. १४. २१.
--an आर्षेयप्रवर (अङ्गिरस्). M. १९६. २१.
--a son of Bharata. भा. V. 7. 3.
--son of Dama. Br. III. ६१. 8.

(also रासगोष्ठि)--in this was seen the same कृष्ण between every two गोपीस्, his hands over the shoulder of each गोपी engaged in dancing and singing, until all of them were tired. भा. X. Ch. २९ (whole); ३३. 2-२२; ३९. २९; ४७. ४३ and ६०, ६२.
--created by ब्रह्मा from his feet. Vi. I. 5. ४९.
--is कृष्ण. Br. III. ३३. २१.
